title: Thumbnail ideas
prompt: Describe three thumbnail ideas for a video called [title]. For each, say the main picture, up to four words of text, and the colors.
popularity_note: Three thumbnail ideas to choose from.

title: Flyer layout
prompt: Plan a one-page flyer for [event] on [date]. Say what goes at the top, the middle, and the bottom, and what to leave off. Use only these facts: [facts].
popularity_note: A flyer plan before you design it.

title: Product clip voiceover
prompt: Write a [length] voiceover for a clip showing [product]. Plain words, one idea per line, and no claims beyond these facts: [facts].
popularity_note: A voiceover tied to your facts.

title: Turn a post into a video
prompt: Turn this post into a 30 second video plan: [post]. List the scenes, the words on screen, and the voiceover for each scene.
popularity_note: A scene plan from a post you already wrote.

title: Three headline options
prompt: Write three headlines for [page or ad] aimed at [customer]. One plain, one curious, one direct. Use only these facts: [facts].

title: Newsletter outline
prompt: Outline a short newsletter for [audience] this month with three parts: [news], one tip, and one question for readers. Draft only. Do not send.

title: Step-by-step guide
prompt: Write a step-by-step guide for [task] that a new helper could follow. Number the steps and mark any step that needs a judgment call.
popularity_note: Steps a new helper can follow.

title: Monthly budget sheet
prompt: Set up a monthly budget sheet for [household or business]. Give the rows, the columns, and the formulas for the totals. Use these amounts: [amounts]. Leave a blank for any amount I did not give.
popularity_note: A budget layout with totals worked out.

title: Tidy a list for a sheet
prompt: Clean up this list so it fits a spreadsheet: [list]. One item per row, fix spelling, remove repeats, and tell me what you changed.
popularity_note: A clean list, with the changes named.

title: About page draft
prompt: Draft an About page for [business] from these facts: [facts]. Warm, plain words, under [length]. Do not invent history or awards.
popularity_note: An About page from your own facts.

title: Small script, explained
prompt: Write a small [language] script that [task]. Explain each part in plain words and say what to check before you run it.
popularity_note: A script with each part explained.

title: Voicemail script
prompt: Write a voicemail under 30 seconds for [name] about [reason]. Say who I am, why I called, and how to reach me: [contact]. Draft only.

title: FAQ from questions
prompt: Turn these customer questions into a short FAQ: [questions]. Answer only from these facts: [facts]. Mark any answer you could not find.
